description: PyPVRPM is a Python reliability and performance model for solar photovoltaic systems. It couples a user-defined PV installation with stochastic component failures, detection and repair assumptions, then estimates energy yield and financial measures including levelized cost of energy. Its solar-performance calculations use the NREL System Advisor Model Python interface. Spatial coverage and study period follow the selected location and scenario; no fixed power plant or outage history is included. The public repository and documentation are BSD-3-Clause. The model can compare how maintenance or failure rates affect generation capacity and investment choices. A caveat is that failure distributions require evidence from comparable equipment, and predicted cost metrics depend on financial assumptions. The catalogue model-system-advisor-model-sam covers the underlying energy-yield engine, while PyPVRPM is a distinct reliability layer. No first-review draft or catalogue record matched this layer. This review read the JOSS article and own repository without running a PV project.
